title: Got a Formula 1 question? Ask the Prime Tire newsletter
content:
Got an F1 question you’ve been too embarrassed to ask? Good news: We’ve been watching this sport for years and still get confused from time to time.

So consider this the no-dumb-questions zone of Formula 1.

Basic, deep or embarrassingly specific — it’s all fair game. Confused about a penalty or team orders? Never quite understood what a bargeboard is? That’s fine. Let’s do it. Send us whatever you’ve been too afraid to ask your friends, and we’ll regularly answer submissions in our Prime Tire newsletter.

By clicking the submit button, you agree that you have read, understand and accept the Reader Submission Terms in relation to all of the content and other information you send to us (“Your Content”). If you do not accept these terms, do not submit any content.

Not yet subscribed to Prime Tire? Sign up here to get the newsletter for free, twice a week during the season, and read past editions here. And check out The Athletic’s other newsletters, too.
